items.title: SoundCloud to allow direct music purchases
items.summary: SoundCloud is beta-testing a direct purchase feature with 200 Artist Pro users ahead of a wider rollout this fall.

items.title: Dolly Parton dies at 80
items.summary: The country icon has died at 80 after a brief illness, prompting tributes across the music and film industries.

items.title: YouTube Premium prices rise in Europe and Singapore
items.summary: Individual plan prices are climbing roughly 10-15% across several European markets and in Singapore.

items.title: ARIA blocks AI-generated recordings from Australia's official charts
items.summary: An updated Charts Code of Practice bars AI-made recordings from Australia's official charts starting with the August 31 edition.

items.title: Universal, Sony & Warner join $76M funding round in Stability AI
items.summary: The three majors invest in Stability AI's Series B alongside Electronic Arts and AMD Ventures.

items.title: Round Hill sues Suno and Anthropic over AI music training
items.summary: Round Hill Music files suits against AI companies, seeking up to $1B in statutory damages per case.

items.title: Sony Music sues Kroger over unauthorized recordings in ads
items.summary: Sony alleges 392 unauthorized uses of its recordings across Kroger's social media advertising campaigns.

items.title: Olivia Rodrigo fights scalpers as Ticketmaster cancels breach tickets
items.summary: Ticketmaster voided tickets that breached sale terms for Olivia Rodrigo's tour dates.

items.title: DSW reaches settlement in principle with Sony Music over ad music
items.summary: Designer Shoe Warehouse and Sony settle a dispute over unauthorized music used in social ads.

items.title: Core Sampler is "the sampler Pro Tools should already have"
items.summary: Film composer Nico Borromeo built Core Sampler, a new plugin that turns musical ideas directly into timeline audio clips.

items.title: Dr. Dre says he is "embracing" AI: "It's a new tool for creativity"
items.summary: Dre compares AI skepticism to past resistance against drum machines and synths, framing it as a legit creative tool.

items.title: Jeff Mills reworks his 1995 Liquid Room set in Spatial Audio
items.summary: The techno pioneer remixed his historic Tokyo set using 14 microphones to capture venue ambience in spatial audio.

items.title: Tamber music creation suite gets a 2.0 update
items.summary: All five core tools in the Tamber suite gain functionality and organization improvements in this major version update.

items.title: Ableton Note 2.1 for iOS quietly overhauls how you work
items.summary: The mobile Ableton app update refines Clips, Warp Markers and adds a landscape mode UI that changes daily workflow.

items.title: 1010music Bluebox 1.5 mixer module gets a major update
items.summary: The hardware mixer and desktop combo adds new details aimed at consolidating Eurorack and hardware rig signal routing.

items.title: Minimal Audio launches Lucid, a granular multi-effect plugin
items.summary: The new pulsing purple effect slices, stretches and scrubs sound, spanning ambient drones to tempo-synced rhythmic textures.

items.title: Organismi OR-1, a free generative MIDI sequencer, launches for iPad
items.summary: The breathing, stochastic pattern generator ships free for iPad as an AUv3, with a paid macOS desktop version.

items.title: Queens of the Stone Age reveal new album Perfecth
items.summary: The band announced their new album alongside a new song titled "Insignificant Other".

items.title: Olivia Rodrigo releases new song "Serena Joy"
items.summary: The one-off single takes its name from a character in Margaret Atwood's "The Handmaid's Tale".

items.title: ILP's breakdown for The Mandalorian and Grogu
items.summary: Important Looking Pirates details environments and CG character work for the new Star Wars feature.

items.title: Framestore's explosive VFX breakdown for War Machine
items.summary: Framestore details a CG killing machine blending dinosaur and robotic design for the film.

items.title: DNEG's VFX breakdown for For All Mankind Season 5

items.summary: DNEG's Daniel Baldwin details fire, full-CG crashes and seamless camera handoffs built to go unnoticed on screen.

items.title: Inside the VFX of Stranger Things Season 5
items.summary: The VFX supervisor breaks down creature design and digital effects meant to enhance rather than replace reality.

items.summary: The Toronto studio's 81 artists delivered ~150 shots, from practical-doll matching to creature transformations.

items.summary: The studio built 73 hero creature assets and over 100 environments, including 13 real-time Unreal Engine environments.

items.title: Six thousand people made a three-minute film about a hopeful future

items.title: How the Camp Miasma team used a glass matte painting shot

items.title: VIEW Conference 2026 adds Brad Bird talk on Ray Gunn

items.title: Reallusion launches AccuFACE 2 facial mocap for CC5 HD characters

items.title: Autodesk Flow Studio adds a 3D Editor + Canvas for AI filmmaking
items.summary: The platform pairs interactive 3D scene building with generative 2D video models for more directable results.

items.title: Apple unveils new M5 Ultra and M6 processors
items.summary: Apple's latest chips deliver performance gains for creative apps including Nuke and Redshift rendering.

items.title: Promising new Blender retopology tool Smart Remesh appears
items.summary: A context-aware add-on converts organic and hard-surface models into clean quad geometry, preserving vertex positions.

items.title: CLO Virtual Fashion releases Marvelous Designer 2026.1
items.summary: The 3D garment tool adds fabric-wrinkle painting and seamline ripping for more detailed cloth work.

items.title: Foundry releases Nuke 17.1
items.summary: The compositor adds Gaussian splat relighting, Hydra 2.0 viewport support and expanded 3D system capabilities.

items.title: Impossible Objects supercharges VFX with AI on HP ZGX Nano

items.title: Sam Register exits Warner Bros. Animation after 18 years

items.title: 2026 Visual Effects & Animation World Atlas shows 2.7% growth
items.summary: The industry report finds net growth, an 11.3% Vancouver rebound, and no evidence AI has cut VFX jobs.

items.title: France faces a thorny Oscar submission choice over Zvyagintsev's Minotaur
items.summary: France weighs submitting an exiled filmmaker's Russia-set drama for the Oscars against strong homegrown contenders.

items.title: Barry Keoghan to lead and produce Top Boy prequel Jonny Boy at Netflix
items.summary: Creator Ronan Bennett returns to write the five-episode prequel, with Drake again executive producing.

items.title: Rupert Grint to reprise Ron Weasley in Harry Potter and the Cursed Child on Broadway
items.summary: The actor joins the Broadway cast to play the grown-up Ron from Feb. 2 to May 30, 2027.

items.title: Oasis documentary captures Gallagher brothers' reconciliation on camera
items.summary: A Disney+ documentary captured Liam and Noel Gallagher's on-camera reunion after 15 years apart, a Disney exec revealed.

items.title: Emily in Paris sets Christmas Eve release for final Season 6
items.summary: Netflix set a Dec. 24 premiere for the series' sixth and final season, with new photos showing a Greek storyline.

items.title: Alice and Steve renewed for Season 2 at Disney+
items.summary: The British comedy starring Jemaine Clement and Nicola Walker returns for a second season on Disney+ and Hulu.

items.title: Netflix sets Roald Dahl series with Nicola Coughlan and Imelda Staunton
items.summary: Danny Brocklehurst will write a six-part drama adapting Dahl's short stories for adults for Netflix.

items.title: Universal Film and Focus Features extend Sundance Institute partnership
items.summary: The studios announce the 2026 Sundance Institute Breakthrough | Focus Features Fellows, backing rising filmmakers.

items.title: Disney+ greenlights wedding planner rom-com from playwright Kate Cortesi
items.summary: The six-part series follows a British wedding planner in the Italian countryside whose chaotic love life resurfaces.

items.summary: A particle-FX artist details setting ACEScg from the first blockout to avoid costly mid-show color pipeline fixes.

items.title: Native Blender 5.3.0 dispersion in Principled BSDF draws attention
items.summary: An artist highlights Blender's new native dispersion shader, showing realistic caustics rendered without third-party add-ons.

items.title: Dust Particles+ Blender add-on patches a Blender 5.2 LTS sprite bug
items.summary: Developers ship a v1.3.1 bugfix for their particle add-on, temporarily dropping spherical falloff while they find a fix.

items.title: Developer lets two AI rigs design their own server rack via Blender MCP
items.summary: A developer shows AI hardware agents using Blender's MCP integration to autonomously design a rack for themselves.

items.title: sonible launches smart:chain, an AI channel strip, for €99
items.summary: Producers are sharing sonible's new intelligent channel strip that auto-configures EQ, compression and more.

items.title: CHIPFORGE: a tracker, synth and drum machine built for PipeWire
items.summary: A new chiptune-focused music tool built directly on PipeWire is getting attention from Linux music makers.

items.title: Samplesonics releases OpenWav Media Browser, a free sample manager
items.summary: A new free sample management tool for producers is being shared across the music-production fediverse.

items.title: ConjureDSP releases ConjureAlign, a free phase-alignment tool

items.title: Bitwig Studio 6.1 update pushes the sampler further

items.title: Dyrekreds synth plugin seeks macOS beta testers

items.title: A screenwriter is building story-structure tools in the open
items.summary: @constructurescreenwriter is posting a running series on outline, beats and character panels for a new writing app.

items.title: BBC offers £50,000 per YouTube documentary for 16-24 year-olds
items.summary: The commissioning scheme funds lean teams to deliver 25-minute-plus documentaries in about three months, aimed at young filmmakers.

items.title: "Rupert Grint" spiking in US search

items.title: "GTA 6" spiking in French search
items.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is trending hard in France (2,000+) — a cross-over signal across gaming and entertainment.
